chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, all from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Zurara and Al-Fudayl, who said:
We said to him (peace be upon him), 'Is it sufficient if I perform the ritual bath after dawn for Friday?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'Yes.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform the Friday ritual bath after Fajr prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi, transmitted through the chain of Zurarah and al-Fudayl, clarifies the permissibility of performing the Friday ritual bath (ghusl) after the dawn prayer, reflecting the Shia juristic view that the time for this specific act begins with the entry of Fajr. It highlights the practical flexibility in Shia fiqh regarding the preparation for congregational prayer, distinguishing the timing of the bath from the strict time limits of other ritual purifications.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin ShAzaan, altogether from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Zurara and Al Fuzayl who both said,
‘We both said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Would it suffice if the washing for the Friday is done after the dawn?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from and Muhammad ibn ‘Isma’il fom from af-Fadf ibn Shadhan all from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from Zurarah and al-Fudayl who has narrated the following: “
We once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, if taking Ghusl (bath) after dawn on Friday is sufficient. He (the Imam) replied, ’Yes it is sufficient.’”
